LOGFILTER.desc: This group can be used to configure the data logger, i.e. to enable/disable the log recording and to get/set the position entry filter settings.

MOT.title: Motion detector configuration
MOT.desc: The items in this group specify the parameters used for the internal receiver motion detector. The platform motion is assessed by combining the detected motion of different detectors looking at specific data types (i.e. GNSS, gyroscopes, accelerometers, wheel ticks). The decision thresholds of the internal detectors can be specified using the configuration items in this group.

NAV2.title: Secondary output configuration
NAV2.desc: This group contains configuration items related to the secondary (NAV2) output.

NAVHPG.title: High precision navigation configuration
NAVHPG.desc: This group configures items related to the operation of the receiver in high precision, for example Differential correction and other related features.

NAVSPG.title: Standard precision navigation configuration
NAVSPG.desc: This group contains configuration items related to the operation of the receiver at standard precision, including configuring position fix mode, ionospheric model selection and other related items.

NMEA.title: NMEA protocol configuration
NMEA.desc: This group configures the NMEA protocol. See section NMEA protocol configuration for a detailed description of the configuration effects on NMEA output.

ODO.title: Odometer and low-speed course over ground filter configuration
ODO.desc: The items in this group allow the user to configure the Odometer feature and Low-Speed Course Over Ground Filter.

QZSS.title: QZSS system configuration
QZSS.desc: Note that enabling and disabling of individual GNSS is done via the CFG-SIGNAL configuration group.

RATE.title: Navigation and measurement rate configuration
RATE.desc: The configuration items in this group allow the user to alter the rate at which navigation solutions (and the measurements that they depend on) are generated by the receiver. The calculation of the navigation solution is aligned to the top of a second zero (first second of the week) of the configured reference time system. The navigation period is an integer multiple of the measurement period.

RINV.title: Remote inventory
RINV.desc: The remote inventory enables storing user-defined data in the receiver's non-volatile memory. The data can be either binary or a string of ASCII characters. In the latter case, it can optionally be output at startup after the boot screen.

SBAS.title: SBAS configuration
SBAS.desc: This group configures the SBAS receiver subsystem (i.e. WAAS, EGNOS, MSAS). See SBAS configuration settings description in the integration manual for a detailed description of how these settings affect receiver operation.

SIGNAL.title: Satellite systems (GNSS) signal configuration
SIGNAL.desc: The enable items for individual signals are governed by their corresponding constellation enable item. It is necessary that at least one signal from a major GNSS constellation is enabled. See GNSS signal configuration in the integration manual for more details.

CFG-GAL-OSNMA_MINTAGLENGTH.title: Minimum equivalent tag length
CFG-GAL-OSNMA_MINTAGLENGTH.desc: Navigation data authentication is achieved after verifying a minimum number of tag bits associated to the same navigation data set. The receiver shall accumulate N tags of length L bits such that L x N >= OSNMA_MINTAGLENGTH.

CFG-GAL-OSNMA_TIMESYNC.title: Apply the time synchronization requirement
CFG-GAL-OSNMA_TIMESYNC.desc: The security of OSNMA protocol against delayed attacks depends on the fulfilment by the receiver of the time synchronization requirement described in Annex C of OSNMA Receiver Guidelines (Issue 1.3, January 2024). The time synchronization requirement establishes that, to apply OSNMA protocol, the receiver must know an estimation of the Galileo System Time and its uncertainty from an independent and trusted source. This configuration key allows to activate OSNMA protocol execution even if no external time is provided, as it will still provide protection against certain spoofing attacks.

CFG-NAV2-NAVSPG_ONLY_AUTHDATA.desc: If enabled, the receiver uses only signals with authenticated navigation data. This configuration item allows configuring the authenticated only navigation feature differently for the primary output and the secondary output. For configuring the primary output, see CFG-NAVSPG-ONLY_AUTHDATA.

CFG-NAV2-OUT_ENABLED.title: Enable secondary (NAV2) output
CFG-NAV2-OUT_ENABLED.desc: Enables the secondary output (GNSS standalone output). It can be used simultaneously with the available primary output (high precision, sensor fusion or time mode output).

CFG-NAV2-SBAS_USE_INTEGRITY.title: Use SBAS integrity information in the secondary output
CFG-NAV2-SBAS_USE_INTEGRITY.desc: If enabled, the receiver uses only GPS satellites for which integrity information is available. This configuration item allows configuring the SBAS integrity feature differently for the primary output and the secondary output. For configuring the primary output, see CFG-SBAS-USE_INTEGRITY.

CFG-NAVSPG-CONSTR_DGNSSTO_SCALE.desc: DGNSS timeout value is calculated as "CFG-NAVSPG-CONSTR_DGNSSTO * CFG-NAVSPG-CONSTR_DGNSSTO_SCALE". The default scaling is 1, meaning the CFG-NAVSPG-CONSTR_DGNSSTO value is used as-is. When set, the value must be 1 or greater.

CFG-NAVSPG-PL_ENA.desc: If enabled, protection level computing is on.

CFG-NAVSPG-USE_USRDAT.title: Use user geodetic datum parameters
CFG-NAVSPG-USE_USRDAT.desc: User specified geodetic system can be used instead of the receiver's default WGS84 ellipsoid. All of the CFG-NAVSPG-USERDAT_* user geodetic datum parameters listed here must be configured before enabling the user specified geodetic system.

CFG-NAVSPG-USRDAT_DX.title: Geodetic datum X axis shift at the origin

CFG-NAVSPG-USRDAT_DY.title: Geodetic datum Y axis shift at the origin

CFG-NAVSPG-USRDAT_ROTX.title: Geodetic datum rotation about the X axis

CFG-NAVSPG-USRDAT_ROTZ.title: Geodetic datum rotation about the Z axis

CFG-NAVSPG-USRDAT_SCALE.title: Geodetic datum scale factor
CFG-NAVSPG-USRDAT_SCALE.desc: Accepted range is 0.0 to 50.0 parts per million.

CFG-NAVSPG-UTCSTANDARD.desc: See section GNSS time base in the integration manual.

CFG-NAVSPG-WKNROLLOVER.desc: GPS week numbers are set correctly from this week up to 1024 weeks after this week.

CFG-NMEA-BDSTALKERID.title: BeiDou Talker ID
CFG-NMEA-BDSTALKERID.desc: Sets the two ASCII characters that should be used for the BeiDou Talker ID.

CFG-NMEA-COMPAT.title: Enable compatibility mode
CFG-NMEA-COMPAT.desc: This might be needed for certain applications, e.g. for an NMEA parser that expects a fixed number of digits in position coordinates.

CFG-NMEA-CONSIDER.title: Enable considering mode
CFG-NMEA-CONSIDER.desc: This affects the way the used satellite count in NMEA output is calculated. If set, also considered but rejected satellites (e.g. RAIMED) are counted as used satellites as well.

CFG-NMEA-GSVTALKERID.title: Talker ID for GSV NMEA messages
CFG-NMEA-GSVTALKERID.desc: By default the Talker ID for GSV messages is GNSS-specific (as defined by NMEA).

CFG-NMEA-HIGHPREC.title: Enable high precision mode
CFG-NMEA-HIGHPREC.desc: This flag cannot be set in conjunction with either CFG-NMEA-COMPAT or CFG-NMEA-LIMIT82 mode.

CFG-NMEA-LIMIT82.title: Enable strict limit to 82 characters maximum NMEA message length

CFG-NMEA-MAINTALKERID.title: Main Talker ID
CFG-NMEA-MAINTALKERID.desc: By default the main Talker ID (i.e. the Talker ID used for all messages other than GSV) is determined by the GNSS assignment of the receiver's channels (see CFG-SIGNAL).

CFG-NMEA-OUT_MSKFIX.title: Enable position output for invalid fixes

CFG-NMEA-OUT_ONLYGPS.title: Restrict output to GPS satellites only

CFG-NMEA-SVNUMBERING.desc: Configures the display of satellites that do not have an NMEA-defined value.

CFG-ODO-COGLPGAIN.title: Course over ground low-pass filter level (at speed < 8 m/s)

CFG-ODO-COGMAXPOSACC.title: Maximum acceptable position accuracy for computing low-speed filtered course over ground

CFG-ODO-COGMAXSPEED.title: Upper speed limit for low-speed course over ground filter

CFG-ODO-OUTLPCOG.title: Output low-pass filtered course over ground (heading)

CFG-ODO-USE_COG.title: Use low-speed course over ground filter

CFG-QZSS-SLAS_MAX_BASELINE.title: Maximum baseline distance to closest GMS
CFG-QZSS-SLAS_MAX_BASELINE.desc: SLAS corrections are only applied if the receiver is at most this far away from the closest ground monitoring station (GMS). Note that due to the nature of the service, the usefulness of corrections degrades with distance. When far away from GMS, SBAS may be a better correction source.

CFG-QZSS-USE_SLAS_RAIM_UNCORR.title: Raim out measurements that are not corrected by QZSS SLAS, if at least 5 measurements are corrected

CFG-QZSS-USE_SLAS_TESTMODE.title: Use QZSS SLAS data when it is in test mode (SLAS msg 0)

CFG-RATE-MEAS.title: Nominal time between GNSS measurements
CFG-RATE-MEAS.desc: E.g. 100 ms results in 10 Hz measurement rate, 1000 ms = 1 Hz measurement rate.

CFG-RATE-NAV.title: Ratio of number of measurements to number of navigation solutions
CFG-RATE-NAV.desc: E.g. 5 means five measurements for every navigation solution. The minimum value is 1. The maximum value is 127.

CFG-RATE-TIMEREF.title: Time system to which measurements are aligned

CFG-RINV-BINARY.title: Data is binary
CFG-RINV-BINARY.desc: When true, the data is treated as binary data.

CFG-RINV-CHUNK0.title: Data bytes 1-8 (LSB)
CFG-RINV-CHUNK0.desc: Data to store/stored in remote inventory - max 8 bytes, left-most in LSB, e.g. string ABCD will appear as 0x44434241.

CFG-RINV-CHUNK1.title: Data bytes 9-16
CFG-RINV-CHUNK1.desc: Data to store/stored in remote inventory - max 8 bytes, left-most in LSB, e.g. string ABCD will appear as 0x44434241.

CFG-RINV-CHUNK2.title: Data bytes 17-24
CFG-RINV-CHUNK2.desc: Data to store/stored in remote inventory - max 8 bytes, left-most in LSB, e.g. string ABCD will appear as 0x44434241.

CFG-RINV-CHUNK3.title: Data bytes 25-30 (MSB)
CFG-RINV-CHUNK3.desc: Data to store/stored in remote inventory - max 6 bytes, left-most in LSB, e.g. string ABCD will appear as 0x44434241.

CFG-RINV-DATA_SIZE.title: Size of data
CFG-RINV-DATA_SIZE.desc: Size of data to store/stored in the remote inventory (maximum 30 bytes).

CFG-RINV-DUMP.title: Dump data at startup
CFG-RINV-DUMP.desc: When true, data is dumped to the interface at startup, unless CFG-RINV-BINARY is set.

CFG-RTCM-DF003_IN.title: RTCM DF003 (Reference station ID) input value
CFG-RTCM-DF003_IN.desc: Value to use for filtering out RTCM input messages based on their DF003 data field (Reference station ID) value. To be used in conjunction with CFG-RTCM-DF003_IN_FILTER. The value can be 0..4095.

CFG-RTCM-DF003_IN_FILTER.title: RTCM input filter configuration based on RTCM DF003 (Reference station ID) value
CFG-RTCM-DF003_IN_FILTER.desc: Configures if and how the filtering out of RTCM input messages based on their DF003 data field (Reference station ID) operates.

consts.name: DISABLED
consts.title: Disabled RTCM input filter; all input messages allowed

consts.name: RELAXED
consts.title: Relaxed RTCM input filter; input messages allowed must contain a DF003 data field matching the CFG-RTCM-DF003_IN value or not contain by specification the DF003 data field

consts.name: STRICT
consts.title: Strict RTCM input filter; input messages allowed must contain a DF003 data field matching the CFG-RTCM-DF003 value

CFG-RTCM-DF003_OUT.title: RTCM DF003 (Reference station ID) output value
CFG-RTCM-DF003_OUT.desc: Value to set in RTCM data field DF003 (Reference station ID) in RTCM output messages containing DF003. The value can be 0..4095.

CFG-SBAS-ACCEPT_NOT_IN_PRNMASK.title: Accept corrections from SBAS SV, even if not self included in PRN MASK (Message Type 1)
CFG-SBAS-ACCEPT_NOT_IN_PRNMASK.desc: If enabled, the receiver will still use the SBAS data, even when the SBAS SV itself is not included in its PRN MASK. This is only useful for BDSBAS and not compatible whith current EGNOS implementation.

CFG-SBAS-PRNSCANMASK.title: SBAS PRN search configuration
CFG-SBAS-PRNSCANMASK.desc: This configuration item determines which SBAS PRNs should be searched. Setting it to 0 indicates auto-scanning all SBAS PRNs. For non-zero values the bits correspond to the allocated SBAS PRNs ranging from PRN120 (bit 0) to PRN158 (bit 38), where a bit set enables searching for the corresponding PRN.

consts.name: ALL
consts.title: Enable search for all SBAS PRNs

CFG-SBAS-USE_INTEGRITY.title: Use SBAS integrity information
CFG-SBAS-USE_INTEGRITY.desc: If enabled, the receiver uses only GPS satellites for which integrity information is available

CFG-SBAS-USE_RANGING.title: Use SBAS GEOs as a ranging source (for navigation)

CFG-SBAS-USE_TESTMODE.title: Use SBAS data when it is in test mode (SBAS msg 0)

CFG-SEC-CFG_LOCK.title: Configuration lockdown
CFG-SEC-CFG_LOCK.desc: When set, the receiver configuration is locked and cannot be changed any more.

CFG-SEC-CFG_LOCK_UNLOCKGRP1.title: Configuration lockdown exempted group 1
CFG-SEC-CFG_LOCK_UNLOCKGRP1.desc: This item can be set before enabling the configuration lockdown. It enables writing to the specified group even after the configuration lockdown has been enabled.

CFG-SEC-CFG_LOCK_UNLOCKGRP2.title: Configuration lockdown exempted group 2
CFG-SEC-CFG_LOCK_UNLOCKGRP2.desc: This item can be set before enabling the configuration lockdown. It enables writing to the specified group even after the configuration lockdown has been enabled.

CFG-SEC-JAMDET_SENSITIVITY_HI.title: When set, go for a more sensitive jamming detection (at the cost of increased false alarm rate).

CFG-SEC-SPOOFDET_SIM_SIG_DIS.title: Disabling the simulated signal spoofing detection.

CFG-SIGNAL-PLAN.title: Active signal plan
CFG-SIGNAL-PLAN.desc: Select the active signal plan of the receiver. Multiple options exist. Not all signal plans are available in this product. See UBX-MON-GNSS for the signal plans available in this product.

CFG-SPI-CPHASE.title: Clock phase select: 0: Data captured on first edge of SCLK, 1: Data captured on second edge of SCLK

CFG-SPI-CPOLARITY.title: Clock polarity select: 0: Active Hight Clock, SCLK idles low, 1: Active Low Clock, SCLK idles high

CFG-SPI-ENABLED.title: Flag to indicate if the SPI interface should be enabled

CFG-SPI-EXTENDEDTIMEOUT.title: Flag to disable timeouting the interface after 1.5s

CFG-SPI-MAXFF.title: Number of bytes containing 0xFF to receive before switching off reception. Range: 0 (mechanism off) - 63

CFG-SPIINPROT-NMEA.title: Flag to indicate if NMEA should be an input protocol on SPI

CFG-SPIINPROT-RTCM3X.title: Flag to indicate if RTCM3X should be an input protocol on SPI

CFG-SPIINPROT-SPARTN.title: Flag to indicate if SPARTN should be an input protocol on SPI

CFG-SPIINPROT-UBX.title: Flag to indicate if UBX should be an input protocol on SPI

CFG-SPIOUTPROT-NMEA.title: Flag to indicate if NMEA should be an output protocol on SPI

CFG-SPIOUTPROT-RTCM3X.title: Flag to indicate if RTCM3X should be an output protocol on SPI

CFG-SPIOUTPROT-UBX.title: Flag to indicate if UBX should be an output protocol on SPI

CFG-TMODE-ECEF_X.desc: This will only be used if CFG-TMODE-MODE=FIXED and CFG-TMODE-POS_TYPE=ECEF.

CFG-TMODE-ECEF_X_HP.title: High-precision ECEF X coordinate of the ARP position.

CFG-TMODE-ECEF_Y.title: ECEF Y coordinate of the ARP position.
CFG-TMODE-ECEF_Y.desc: This will only be used if CFG-TMODE-MODE=FIXED and CFG-TMODE-POS_TYPE=ECEF.

CFG-TMODE-ECEF_Y_HP.title: High-precision ECEF Y coordinate of the ARP position.

CFG-TMODE-ECEF_Z.title: ECEF Z coordinate of the ARP position.

CFG-TMODE-ECEF_Z_HP.title: High-precision ECEF Z coordinate of the ARP position.

CFG-TMODE-HEIGHT.title: Height of the ARP position.
CFG-TMODE-HEIGHT.desc: This will only be used if CFG-TMODE-MODE=FIXED and CFG-TMODE-POS_TYPE=LLH.

CFG-TMODE-HEIGHT_HP.title: High-precision height of the ARP position.

CFG-TMODE-LAT.title: Latitude of the ARP position.
CFG-TMODE-LAT.desc: This will only be used if CFG-TMODE-MODE=FIXED and CFG-TMODE-POS_TYPE=LLH.

CFG-TMODE-LAT_HP.title: High-precision latitude of the ARP position

CFG-TMODE-LON.title: Longitude of the ARP position.
CFG-TMODE-LON.desc: This will only be used if CFG-TMODE-MODE=FIXED and CFG-TMODE-POS_TYPE=LLH.

CFG-TMODE-LON_HP.title: High-precision longitude of the ARP position.

consts.name: FIXED
consts.title: Fixed mode (true ARP position information required)

CFG-TMODE-POS_TYPE.title: Determines whether the ARP position is given in ECEF or LAT/LON/HEIGHT?

CFG-TMODE-SVIN_ACC_LIMIT.title: Survey-in position accuracy limit
CFG-TMODE-SVIN_ACC_LIMIT.desc: This will only be used if CFG-TMODE-MODE=SURVEY_IN.

CFG-TMODE-SVIN_MIN_DUR.title: Survey-in minimum duration
CFG-TMODE-SVIN_MIN_DUR.desc: This will only be used if CFG-TMODE-MODE=SURVEY_IN.

CFG-TP-ALIGN_TO_TOW_TP2.title: Align time pulse to top of second (TP2)
CFG-TP-ALIGN_TO_TOW_TP2.desc: To use this feature, CFG-TP-SYNC_GNSS_TP2 must be set.

CFG-TP-DRSTR_TP2.title: Set drive strength of TP2
CFG-TP-DRSTR_TP2.desc: Time Pulse pin 2 (TP2) can support 4 possible drive strength cases: 2, 4, 8 and 12 mA

CFG-TP-DUTY_LOCK_TP2.title: Time pulse duty cycle when locked to GNSS time (TP2)
CFG-TP-DUTY_LOCK_TP2.desc: Only used if CFG-TP-PULSE_LENGTH_DEF=RATIO and CFG-TP-USE_LOCKED_TP2 are set.

CFG-TP-DUTY_TP2.title: Time pulse duty cycle (TP2) in [%]
CFG-TP-DUTY_TP2.desc: Only used if CFG-TP-PULSE_LENGTH_DEF=RATIO is set.

CFG-TP-FREQ_LOCK_TP2.title: Time pulse frequency when locked to GNSS time (TP2) in [Hz]
CFG-TP-FREQ_LOCK_TP2.desc: Only used if CFG-TP-PULSE_DEF=FREQ and CFG-TP-USE_LOCKED_TP2 is set.

CFG-TP-LEN_LOCK_TP2.title: Time pulse length when locked to GNSS time (TP2) in [us]
CFG-TP-LEN_LOCK_TP2.desc: Only used if CFG-TP-PULSE_LENGTH_DEF=LENGTH and CFG-TP-USE_LOCKED_TP2 is set.

CFG-TP-LEN_TP2.title: Time pulse length (TP2) in [us]
CFG-TP-LEN_TP2.desc: Only used if CFG-TP-PULSE_LENGTH_DEF=LENGTH is set.

CFG-TP-PERIOD_LOCK_TP2.title: Time pulse period when locked to GNSS time (TP2) in [us]
CFG-TP-PERIOD_LOCK_TP2.desc: Only used if CFG-TP-PULSE_DEF=PERIOD and CFG-TP-USE_LOCKED_TP2 is set.

CFG-TP-PERIOD_TP2.title: Time pulse period (TP2) in [us]
CFG-TP-PERIOD_TP2.desc: This is used only if CFG-TP-PULSE_DEF=PERIOD.

CFG-TP-POL_TP2.title: Set time pulse polarity (TP2)
CFG-TP-POL_TP2.desc: false (0) : falling edge at top of second.

CFG-TP-PULSE_DEF.title: Determines whether the time pulse is interpreted as frequency or period

CFG-TP-PULSE_LENGTH_DEF.title: Determines whether the time pulse length is interpreted as length[us] or pulse ratio[%]

CFG-TP-SYNC_GNSS_TP2.title: Sync time pulse to GNSS time or local clock (TP2)
CFG-TP-SYNC_GNSS_TP2.desc: If set, sync to GNSS if GNSS time is valid. Otherwise, use local clock.

CFG-TP-TIMEGRID_TP2.title: Time grid to use (TP2)
CFG-TP-TIMEGRID_TP2.desc: Only relevant if CFG-TP-SYNC_GNSS_TP2 is set.

CFG-TP-USE_LOCKED_TP2.title: Use locked parameters when possible (TP2)
CFG-TP-USE_LOCKED_TP2.desc: If set, use CFG-TP-PERIOD_LOCK_TP2 and CFG-TP-LEN_LOCK_TP2 as soon as GNSS time is valid. Otherwise, use CFG-TP-PERIOD_TP2 and CFG-TP-LEN_TP2.

CFG-TXREADY-THRESHOLD.title: Amount of data that should be ready on the interface before triggering the TX ready pin
CFG-TXREADY-THRESHOLD.desc: The value is amount of 8-byte chunks. For example, value of 250 sets the trigger to 2000 bytes.

CFG-NAVCOR-ENABLE_GAL_HAS.title: Enable/disable Galileo HAS corrections
CFG-NAVCOR-ENABLE_GAL_HAS.desc: If this is true, and HOST corrections are not available, Galileo HAS corrections are processed.

CFG-NAVCOR-ENABLE_HOST.title: Enable/disable HOST corrections
CFG-NAVCOR-ENABLE_HOST.desc: If this is true, HOST-based corrections are processed.

CFG-RTCM-DF028_OUT.title: RTCM DF028 (antenna height) output value
CFG-RTCM-DF028_OUT.desc: Height of the antenna reference point (ARP) position above the marker used in the survey campaign. Value is used with RTCM 1006 output and input.

CFG-PMP-CENTER_FREQUENCY.title: Center frequency
CFG-PMP-CENTER_FREQUENCY.desc: The center frequency for the receiver can be set from 1539000000 to 1559000000 Hz. With NEO-D9S, the center frequency for the receiver can be set from 1525000000 to 1559000000 Hz.

CFG-PMP-DATA_RATE.title: Data rate
CFG-PMP-DATA_RATE.desc: The data rate of the received data.

CFG-PMP-DESCRAMBLER_INIT.title: Descrambler initialization
CFG-PMP-DESCRAMBLER_INIT.desc: Set the initialization value for the descrambler.

CFG-PMP-SEARCH_WINDOW.title: Search window
CFG-PMP-SEARCH_WINDOW.desc: Search window can be set from 0 to 65535 Hz. It is +/- this value from the center frequency set by CENTER_FREQUENCY.

CFG-PMP-USE_SERVICE_ID.title: Use service ID
CFG-PMP-USE_SERVICE_ID.desc: Enable/disable service ID check to confirm the correct service is received.

CFG-RTCM-MSM_OUT_RANGERATE_SIGN.title: Sign of the Phaserange rate in RTCM MSM7 and MSM5 output messages
CFG-RTCM-MSM_OUT_RANGERATE_SIGN.desc: If this field is set to 0, the sign of the Phaserange rate is reversed compared to the standard RTCM definition. For example, RTCM standard states that for a continually-tracked approaching satellite the Phaserange will decrease in value and the Phaserange rate will be negative, while with this field set to 0, the Phaserange rate will be positive.
